caption: The drawing contains three distinct elements: on the left, there is a detailed depiction of a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case in brown and reddish tones, featuring an arched top and panel designs on the body, and a glass window at the top displaying the clock face; in the center-right, there is an enlarged close-up view of the clock's face, which is circular and primarily white, with two ornate black clock hands, black numerals for both the hours (1–12) and minutes (5–60), gold and red floral corner decorations, and two smaller dials above the main face, along with a painted human face (likely representing a moon phase) behind a semicircular arch; in the upper right corner, there is a faint, technical line drawing of the clock’s side profile, showing its structural outline in minimal detail. The background is a plain, off-white color. The bottom left has the text "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" written in small letters.
title: Grandfather Clock
